title: Fast list participant counts remain stale after join or leave
reasoning: FastListView caches a church-wide participant count and uses it as part of the queryset cache key. It provides an invalidate_cache method that deletes the church participant count and list caches, but join and leave only invalidate participant-list and user-stats caches. After a user joins or leaves, FastListView can continue using the stale participant count and cached queryset until timeout, causing list responses to show stale participant counts.
reproduction: Fetch the fast list for a church, join or leave a fast, then fetch the same list again before the 10-minute cache timeout; the cached participant-count key and queryset cache can preserve the old participant count.
recommendation: Call the FastListView cache invalidation path, or move it to a shared utility and invoke it from both JoinFastView.perform_update and LeaveFastView.perform_update for the affected church.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests do not cover fast join/leave cache invalidation or fast list response freshness.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test that populates the fast list cache, performs a join and a leave, then asserts the next list response reflects the updated participant count.
minimumFixScope: Invalidate the church participant count and fast list queryset caches whenever membership changes.
